status: research only; no runtime, presets, alignment, host, build/package or git changes
classification: Reused recording, not fresh holdout; metadata-frozen observables plus separately declared exploratory diagnostics; no synthesis-model fit or production constant adoption.

protocol.classification: Protocol frozen from metadata before inspecting these retrigger audio windows; source already used in prior fidelity work, not fresh recording holdout.
protocol.selection: All same-channel/same-pitch Sine99 notes whose predecessor off is within0.1ms of new on, plus the gapped MIDI67/75 onsets at180.855717s (prior off180.414626s). Select by metadata only. Program99 start175.562626s.
frozen_observables: Fixed nominal-frequency complex coefficient (magnitude and phase) in Hann-tapered joint sine/cosine least squares, per left/right/arithmetic mid; preserve absolute carrier phase against one source-time origin so phases across frames are comparable.

Observe windows source[-.15,+.25] around frozen new-note time; estimator widths8,12,20ms and1ms hop. This is short enough to inspect transient overlap; report design condition numbers. Include all metadata fundamental pitches active or released within preceding2s, plus new pitches in following.25s. Reject condition>1e5 and report, never prune retrospectively to improve a preferred result.

No engine/model render or per-model shift/gain/frequency/envelope fit. Nominal equal temperament only in first pass. Slow true detuning appears as phase drift and will be reported rather than corrected away.

A local observed complex change time may be measured in common+20..+100ms search interval using largest 4ms coefficient change, with pre/post descriptors[-40,-15],[+15,+40],[+40,+80]ms relative to that measured change. This is data-derived timing, not hardware gate and not a model optimization.

Compare old held coefficient extrapolation and post-onset coefficient trajectory qualitatively: additive old release can make a decaying complex residual toward a new steady phasor; reuse/reset can cause a discontinuity followed by no independent old residual. One same-frequency mixture cannot uniquely label two voices without stronger phase/reset assumptions.

Amplitude overshoot or notches alone do not identify allocation because old/new phase, attack, chorus/circuit memory, timing delivery and harmonic overlap can cause them. Never assume hardware phase resets to zero.
Primary test MIDI75 at181.737898s: simultaneous fresh79/87 onsets help establish common observed activity. Other zero-gap retriggers are preselected corroboration, not confirmation-only searches.

Any later fitted discriminator or changed estimator must be explicitly separated as exploratory; no production recommendation unless observations exclude an allocation alternative after the listed confounds.
predeclared_limitations: Physical Chorus andReverb are on. Effects can retain prior sound even if oscillator voice is replaced. Early20–30ms may include chorus history, whose exact delay/phase is uncertain.
Actual MIDI hardware arrivals are not captured; prior observed onsets lag global MIDI alignment by40–60ms. No per-model local shifts.
Nominally equal-pitched voices cannot be algebraically separated by one sinusoidal coefficient; slowdetuning/chorus may mimic a residual trajectory.
MIDI75 is not expected to receive a lower held note octave harmonic in the primary181.737898 window; other cases have explicit metadata-based harmonic confounds.
Polyphonic source may have voice stealing; no recovered hardware voice allocator or physical note count can be assumed.

first_pass.method: Hann taper applied to signal and design matrix;local-centered sin/cos+DC design; coefficients rotated back to absolute source phase as(cosCoef-i*sinCoef)*exp(-i*2*pi*frequency*centerSourceSeconds);1ms hop; absolute source-time phase preserved; no frequency/timing/engine fit. Observed change selection uses arithmeticmid4ms complex difference in declared20..100ms interval.

exploratory_demod_protocol.classification: Exploratory sensitivity check declared after first-pass primary75 notch observation; not the frozen primary protocol and not a fresh holdout.
exploratory_demod_protocol.purpose: Test whether the deep final75 retrigger notch survives an estimator without a nearly collinear bass nuisance dictionary.
exploratory_demod_protocol.selection: All8 metadata-frozen cases; report inter-pitch interference, especially target68 near older67, rather than tuning bands per result.
exploratory_demod_protocol.method: Complex mix arithmetic-mid/left/right with exp(-i*2*pi*nominalFrequency*absoluteTime), fixed4th-order Butterworth lowpass at60,90,120Hz, forward/backward filtering on source context[-.5,+.5]s; multiply output by2 for sinusoidal peak amplitude. No fitted phase, pitch or gain. Display central[-.15,+.25]s only. Filter transient smoothing and stopband leakage remain confounds.
exploratory_demod_protocol.observables: Minimum amplitude and timing in frozen nominal+20..+100ms interval, relative to median frozen nominal[-60,-20]ms magnitude; phase either side; compare widths and channels. Report nearest competing fundamental spacing. Use a shared fixed nominal search range, not per-model timing fits.
exploratory_demod_protocol.decision_limit: Persistence of a notch supports actual transient loss rather than joint-basis pathology, but does not itself separate allocator, actual MIDI off/on delivery gap, fast choke or external processing. No engine comparison or production correction in this sensitivity step.

exploratory_phase_protocol.classification: Exploratory descriptive phasor check, declared after first-pass plots; no synthesis-model fit or production adoption score.
exploratory_phase_protocol.selection: Two first-pass accepted20ms cases only, final MIDI75 and earlierMIDI70. Other short dictionaries remain rejected.
exploratory_phase_protocol.method: Use already generated20ms absolute-time complex coefficients. Unwrap arithmetic-mid phase and fit straight lines separately in fixed nominal[-120,+20]ms and[+80,+200]ms windows. Report phase-rate Hz and difference of line predictions at the measured complex-change time modulo2pi. No frequency correction applied to coefficients; no shift chosen to favor a model.
exploratory_phase_protocol.purpose: Distinguish a simple same-carrier phase interpolation explanation for an amplitude notch from an independently observable amplitude loss. An instantaneous equal-amplitude mixture between phasors separated bydelta has minimum blend magnitude abs(cos(delta/2)); compare this geometric benchmark only, not a fitted allocator model.
exploratory_phase_protocol.limits: Actual note-off and note-on arrival may differ. Chorus/spectral leakage and a changing envelope can invalidate equal-amplitude assumptions. Geometric disagreement cannot determine whether hardware reuses, kills, steals, or receives a delivery gap.

conditioning_summary.rule: frozen design condition limit1e5; no dictionary pruning to rescue rejected cases

protocol_qualification: Initial frozen protocol expectation of no lower-note octave harmonic at primary75 was too broad: MIDI39 eighth and MIDI51 fourth harmonics coincide with75. Their levels were not independently bounded. Original frozen protocol is preserved unchanged; direct fundamental dictionary does not separate coincident harmonics.

primary_recorded_observation.classification: Amplitude interruption and phase discontinuity of recorded sinusoidal component; no actual hardware event timestamp

hypotheses.model: instant equal-amplitude phase-only step with positive smoothing
hypotheses.assessment: restricted geometric model insufficient: measured primary phase difference1.220rad implies minimum-1.728dB versus observed-11.011dB; not a complete circuit/recording model

hypotheses.assessment: unvalidated; no discriminating engine render or recovered isolated arrival/gate here; same-frequency component cannot uniquely label two voices
compatible; source events same tick does not record actual hardware arrivals

recommendation: Keep stacking/phase allocation explicitly unverified; do not adopt a specific rule from this evidence. Future dry isolated repeated-note capture with actual MIDI timestamps, several off/on gaps and a nonharmonic held gain-control tone would discriminate alternatives.
